The <b>Grey Memento</b> is a [[Materium#Mementos|Memento]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==

The memento can be displayed on a shelf in the [[Bellhome]] after interacting with the desk.

It appears in the top-left slot of the shelving.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Bellhome.png!Location in Bellhart
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Bellhart 09.png!Displayed inside Bellhome in Bellhart
}}

== How to Acquire ==
Dropped by [[Watcher at the Edge]] in [[Sands of Karak]] after defeating them in combat. Reaching this area requires the use of the [[Silk Soar]].

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Watcher at the Edge 01.png!Location in Sands of Karak
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Sands of Karak 10.png!Watcher at the Edge in Sands of Karak
|Image3 = Screenshot SS Grey Memento 01.png!Grey Memento in Sands of Karak
}}

== Trivia ==
* If Watcher at the Edge's corpse lands in the pit of [[Sandcarver]]s after being defeated, it will be eaten and the Grey Memento spat back out.

{{Gallery
|Image1= Screenshot SS Watcher at the Edge 14.png!Grey Memento spat out by Sandcarvers
}}
